ReleaseNotes: * Added VirtualBox update detection to notify you when a newer Oracle VirtualBox version is available.
* Added a VirtualBox update notification in the main window with direct download access and dismiss support.
* Enhanced the About page with clearer VBoxTrayManager, VirtualBox, and COM status information.
* Added direct VirtualBox download access when VirtualBox is not installed.
* Improved application startup by moving VirtualBox update checks to the background, keeping the splash screen fast and responsive.
* Improved the installer with a redesigned Welcome experience, integrated system-requirements checks, and optional Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts.
* Added installer guidance for missing VirtualBox while continuing to enforce the required .NET 8 Desktop Runtime.
* Refined update-related controls and layouts for better responsiveness at different window sizes.
* Various UI polish and usability improvements.
